# Pixel converter photo fixture

`flower-landscape.jpg` (2560×1920, SHA-256 `1CAE625EEA470B1AF9B1F1EB1FBA46F452F3744052FB7BEA573948A98D400269`) was uploaded by **Umar2z** as own work to [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flower_landscape.jpg). The author dedicated it under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Retrieved 2026-09-28. The 3840×2160 performance file is a local, uncommitted resize generated by `tests/pixel-converter-performance.py`.

`portrait-1024.jpg` (1024×683, SHA-256 `F2BEB9772E49C9BDB28FB5E165B6C1FB5991CE3124B021253F741B8BF7B61BA4`) is a Lanczos resize of **Wendelin Jacober**'s [Portrait (CreativeCommons).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_(CreativeCommons).jpg), 5472×3648. The Commons page and reviewed Flickr source mark the original [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The downloaded original's SHA-256 was `D237BBF13F886B69A376AAD00836403DAFDB8A6BE0062DC98A50E1A6C7B32A48`; retrieved 2026-09-28. This derivative is used to test a human silhouette against the landscape case.

The 1024×768 landscape comparison derivative is generated locally by `tests/pixel-competitor-compare.py` with Pillow Lanczos and is not committed.
